timing_scope.ensemble: time.perf_counter immediately before replica loop until after final context/integrator deletion. Includes per-replica integrator/context creation, compilation when triggered, position and velocity initialization, integration, energy queries and teardown.

timing_scope.per_replica: After velocity initialization through integration, energy queries and replica summary construction; excludes context initialization and teardown.
timing_scope.concurrent_method: Measure completion of all eight replicas on the same one GPU; preserve ensemble initialization and completion scope when reporting speedup.
timing_scope.cold_warm_policy_reason: Brief does not specify cache warmup or repeated cold/warm trials.

scientific.full_series_requirement: Requires additional per-sample output; not present in supplied interface.
scientific.reason: No published fixed-work energy acceptance tolerance or reference values. No tolerance invented.

scoring_interface.independent_references: anchors.json; contextual only, no acceptance anchors.
